// diagnostic

E0083

`{open}` opened on line {line} is never closed

What

`{open}` opened on line {line} is never closed

Why

Every `{open}` needs a matching `{close}`, but {cutoff} came first

Fix

Add `{close}` where the {construct} ends

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0083: tests/ui/prep_value_unclosed.stderr.

Error [E0083]: `{` opened on line 4 is never closed
  --> tests/ui/prep_value_unclosed.jet:4:15
    |
  4 | LIMIT :: prep { 4
    |               ^
  --> tests/ui/prep_value_unclosed.jet:4:18
    |
  4 | LIMIT :: prep { 4
    |                  ^ the binding `WIDTH` comes before the closing `}`
 Why: Every `{` needs a matching `}`, but the binding `WIDTH` came first
 Fix: Add `}` where the prepared value ends
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0083
